# AAJ SCM

> Full-stack supply chain partner for Indian brands — warehousing, fulfillment, transportation and quick-commerce operations powered by a Pan-India network and integrated technology (WMS, OMS, TMS).

AAJ SCM operates multi-client and dedicated warehouses across 12 Indian cities, with scan-based operations, real-time inventory visibility, and SLA-driven dispatch for B2B distribution, D2C and marketplace fulfillment.

## Services

- [Services overview](/services): 3PL, warehousing and supply chain services across India.
- [Warehousing](/services/warehousing): Multi-client and dedicated warehousing with WMS-driven accuracy.
- [B2B Warehousing](/services/b2b-warehousing): Bulk storage and structured distribution for B2B brands.
- [B2C Warehousing](/services/b2c-warehousing): Each-pick fulfillment for D2C and online brands.
- [Ecommerce Fulfillment](/services/ecommerce-fulfillment): Multi-location fulfillment across marketplaces, D2C and omnichannel.
- [Same-Day Delivery](/services/same-day-delivery): Same-day and next-day delivery across Indian metros.
- [Value Added Services](/services/value-added): Kitting, labelling, QC and custom packaging.
- [Returns Management](/services/returns-management): Camera-verified reverse logistics with inventory accountability.
